description: Angular component for a custom action pretty editor in the Thingsboard UI, including layout initialization and form control integration.

classes.name: CustomActionPrettyEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a custom action pretty editor with split layout and form control features.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes split layout after view children are loaded and their changes are detected.

methods.name: initSplitLayout
methods.description: Sets up a split view layout between two panels.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the control is touched.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a new value to the component.

methods.name: onActionUpdated
methods.description: Propagates the updated action if valid.
